# rrweb recorder

This directory contains the browser ESM distribution of `@rrweb/record` version
`2.1.1`, self-hosted so Grammar OS does not contact a recording service or a
runtime CDN.

- Package: `@rrweb/record@2.1.1`
- Runtime file: `record-2.1.1.mjs` (the package's `dist/record.js`)
- SHA-256: `0b89e2d0c046e556255c647bd0d40c973e5f881583f0a14176a7229deb316eed`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The module is loaded only after explicit consent and a Start action in
manufacturer mode. It is not a grammar authority.
